title: Cowboys put non-exclusive franchise tag on George Pickens. Micah Parsons negotiations may hint at next step

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys put non-exclusive franchise tag on George Pickens. Micah Parsons negotiations may hint at next step
sources.description: Pickens and Parsons aren't identical situations. But each inspired more confidence from the Cowboys on the field than off, and each have prompted questions from the Cowboys about their value relative to a quickly-growing market.
